answer: An orchard keeper stops sybil farming when every identity must graft its own branch onto one shared orchard tree, and a graft can only be cut from the previous branch after it survives a full gale season. The nth fake owes n seasons of hands-on tending: the first 1, the second 2, the third 3, so the tenth fake alone owes 10 seasons and twenty fakes together owe 210. Bulk farming fails because one gardener tends one graft per season and no nursery sells a hardened graft, like one weaver spinning one thread on one loom. Each season is tended fresh, never bought.
